MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable and powered USB hub fit my repeated purchases of cables, card readers, and adapters: they could help me connect and use devices I already have.",
    "The HD Fire TV Stick feels like a useful addition to my TV and DVD player setup because it would expand my viewing options, and HD is sufficient for my previously purchased 720p screen."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug and Echo Dot assume I want voice control or home automation, but buying power strips and a Fire tablet does not mean I have that goal.",
    "The 24-port switch and internal 4TB SSD imply networking or computer upgrade projects I have not shown a need for; my memory purchases have been removable cards.",
    "The portable speaker and TV keyboard do not address an evident need: I have not shown a portable audio interest or a PC-connected TV setup."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as interest in a broad range of electronic devices, although I mostly buy accessories for specific practical jobs.",
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in more Alexa products, when compatibility and usefulness matter more to me than staying with the same brand."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated tripod, memory card, card storage, and recent lens cap purchases suggest an ongoing need for photography accessories that this list barely addresses.",
    "The exact equipment and connection matter: HD suits my 720p TV, removable storage matches my card purchases, and a cable is useful only if its connector and length fit my task."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in practical electronics accessories and home viewing, but stretched it into unrelated upgrades and automation."
}
